inspection_lighting.scope: Static geometry inspection studio only; not gameplay lighting.

scope: Static native geometry inspection. Capture PASS is not a realism-quality or gameplay acceptance claim. Earlier preview lighting differed, so this is not a controlled lighting A/B.

m01_standard_swim_front: Wrist and ankle cap bands are no longer visible at whole-body scale.
Crown silhouette is rounder but the opaque hair still reads as a shaped shell.
Torso and limbs remain a stylized authored surface rather than lifelike skin/anatomy.
m01_standard_swim_side: Calf contour is elongated with a higher posterior peak rather than the earlier low round bulge.
Ribcage-to-abdomen profile still has limited anatomical detail.
m01_standard_swim_back: Rear fill makes scapula/waist and glute-to-thigh silhouettes readable.
Full-body wrist/ankle joins show no detached cap bands.
m01_standard_swim_face: Neutral expression, simple eyes/nose/lips and solid hair prevent a realistic-human quality claim.
m01_standard_swim_hands: Forearm-to-wrist surface meets continuously in actual close-up.
Thumb/palm junction, fingertips and separate finger surfaces remain visibly coarse.
m01_standard_swim_ankles: Calf-to-foot visible cap and width step are removed.
Foot/toe geometry is still coarse and faceted at close range.
f01_standard_swim_front: Torso garment is opaque and body-profile silhouette is visible.
The shoulder straps remain separate fixed curves.
f01_standard_swim_side: One shoulder/back swimsuit strap visibly floats above the new anatomical surface; unresolved.
f01_standard_swim_face: Same remaining simplified face and opaque hair-shell limitations as male source.
m01_soft_swim_side: Abdomen/back volume differs from standard without whole-character scaling.
Surface continuity is improved but is not measured-person anatomy reconstruction.
m01_athletic_swim_front: Pectoral/waist and shoulder contours differ locally from standard.
Muscle surface is still stylized; no completed-realism claim.

status: Targeted geometric improvements observed. Art quality remains in progress; root acceptance and animated/contact regression are separate.
